from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection, recording its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the collection")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the known collection) that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate container for all papers parsed from the document collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
